project_type: Serverless full-stack web app (greenfield): React+TS SPA frontend, API Gateway + Lambda (TS) backend, DynamoDB persistence, Amazon Bedrock for AI narrative, AWS CDK (TS) IaC. npm workspaces monorepo.
language: TypeScript (frontend React/Vite, backend Node 20 Lambda, infra CDK)
build_system: npm workspaces monorepo. Root package.json defines workspaces: frontend, backend, infra, shared. Each workspace has its own tsconfig and build script. Vite for frontend, esbuild (via CDK NodejsFunction or tsc) for backend.
test_framework: Vitest for unit tests in backend (prediction logic, data mapping) and frontend (component/logic). No live AWS calls in tests - mock AWS SDK and MLB API.
build_command: npm install (root, installs all workspaces); npm run build (runs typecheck + build across workspaces)
verification_instructions: 1) From repo root run `npm install`. 2) Run `npm run build` and confirm frontend (vite build), backend (tsc), infra (tsc / cdk synth) all compile with no TS errors. 3) Run `npm test`. 4) Run `npm run synth` (cdk synth) to confirm the CDK app produces a CloudFormation template without errors. Do NOT run `cdk deploy` or `cdk bootstrap` - AWS credentials are not active in this session.
snapshot_or_generated_files: cdk.out/ is generated by `cdk synth` and should be gitignored. frontend dist/ and backend dist/ are build artifacts, gitignored. No checked-in snapshots.
setup_instructions: Node v22 available (CDK/Lambda target Node 20 runtime). From repo root: `npm install`. For deploy (performed by user in a session with active AWS creds): `npm run build`, then `cd infra && npx cdk bootstrap && npx cdk deploy` (or a root `npm run deploy` script).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET available for npm install and MLB Stats API fetches. AWS credentials are NOT active this session: do NOT run `cdk deploy`, `cdk bootstrap`, or any live AWS/Bedrock call. Verification is limited to install, typecheck, build, unit tests, and `cdk synth`. Real binary image assets may be hard to generate: provide lightweight generated SVG image assets (teams/brand) committed to the repo, which satisfies the 'actual image assets, not emoji-only' requirement.
contribution_requirements: Kiro University final exam: this must be a NEW project whose first GitHub commit is on/after Sept 21. The repo is currently empty (zero commits) - keep everything coherent as it becomes the first commit. Steering files under .kiro/steering/ must capture University requirements plus product/tech/structure.
key_patterns: MLB Stats API: GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule/postseason?sportId=1&season=YYYY returns dates[].games[] with teams.away/home {team:{id,name}, score, isWinner, leagueRecord}, seriesDescription, seriesGameNumber, gamesInSeries. Aggregate games into series by (seriesDescription + team pair) to build bracket. Lambda caches aggregated bracket JSON in DynamoDB keyed by season; serves to SPA via API Gateway. Bedrock InvokeModel (anthropic.claude-3-haiku / sonnet) generates a natural-language series prediction narrative for the win/loss prediction feature.
relevant_files: shared/src/types.ts (domain types: Team, Game, Series, Bracket, Prediction shared by frontend+backend)
frontend/src/* (React app: Bracket, SeriesCard, StandingsPanel, PredictionPanel)
infra/lib/*-stack.ts (CDK: S3+CloudFront, API Gateway+Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock IAM)
directory_structure: kiro-mlb-postseason/ root. shared/ (common TS types + seed data). backend/ (Lambda handlers, MLB client, prediction, Bedrock). frontend/ (Vite React SPA + SVG assets). infra/ (CDK app). .kiro/steering/ (steering md). .agents/tasks/ (this plan). README.md.
